status: frozen before any replay ran; run_study.py lock pins this file, the signal specification and the data manifest, and run refuses a changed lock

contracts.cost_policy: scheduler/fill_cost_policy.go accepts only fill_role taker_all and spread inside_slippage

data.candles: Hyperliquid perpetual daily candles (candleSnapshot) through platforms/hyperliquid/adapter.py get_ohlcv_candles; venue prices, not a proxy; a bar is kept only from the first daily bar with at least one trade
data.funding: Hyperliquid hourly funding history through shared_tools/funding_fetcher.py load_cached_funding with an isolated cache database; signed rates, never filled
data.lot_metadata: Hyperliquid perpetual szDecimals through platforms/hyperliquid/adapter.py lot_size_decimals, read once at preparation
data.delisting: the venue meta (info type meta, isDelisted) read once at preparation

universe.rule: a named candidate is a member when its first Hyperliquid daily bar with at least one trade opens at or before listing_cutoff, every daily bar from that bar to pinned_end exists with at least one trade (no gap), and the venue meta lists it as not delisted at preparation; the list was written from general large-capitalization knowledge before any return was read
universe.listing_evidence: listed_at and known_at are the open time of the member's first daily bar with at least one trade
universe.survivorship: the candidate list and the not-delisted test use preparation-time knowledge, so a coin that was delisted before pinned_end (MATIC) cannot be a member; this biases every arm toward surviving coins and is reported as a limit

windows.note: both windows start and end their last step on a weekly rebalance deadline (Thursday 00:00 UTC); the training window's last step and the held-out window's first step are the same instant, and no held-out return enters training

amendment: Preparation (before the lock and before any replay or return was read) found one venue-absent Hyperliquid funding hour, 2024-08-15T13:00Z, for every member. A venue-absent hour inside a window leaves the replay incomplete and is never replaced with zero, so the training start moved from 2024-02-01 to the first weekly deadline after it, 2024-08-22; the held-out window is unchanged.

basket.eligibility_source: frozen Hyperliquid daily candles in data/ (first traded bar)

member_close_policy: every arm uses the same member close policy: a fixed 30 percent catastrophic stop (stop_loss_pct) and a 500 percent take-profit tier (profit_pct 5.0 as a fraction) that is not expected to fire; exits otherwise come only from coordinator targets. Without an explicit stop the default ATR stop (1.0 x daily ATR) would close most legs between rebalances

costs.note: rates are fractions per fill; primary equals the frozen paper model (Hyperliquid base taker fee and paper slippage), stress doubles both; every fill books as a taker fill and spread sits inside slippage

selection.eligible: a variant whose training replay status is complete
selection.objective: highest mean weekly after-cost return on the gross budget over the training clusters

equal_weight_hold.rule: weight 1/N long on every member at every weekly deadline, so the coordinator restores equal weights each week

momentum.rule: registered futures defaults; walk the closed-bar signals from the first frozen bar to the deadline bar: signal 1 enters long, signal -1 exits a long (the strategy registers short_entries=False, so -1 never opens a short); weight = position / N

vol_momentum.rule: registered futures defaults (allow_short true); weight = signed position column at the deadline bar / N

baselines.common: every baseline runs through the same replay with the same members, member capital, close policy, costs, gross budget, per-coin cap, decision deadlines and windows; only target_input (baseline weights) and the net allowance differ. Targets use closed bars that close at or before the deadline; a flat member keeps its cash, which is never moved to another member

statistics.cluster: one rebalance period: from the equity after the step at one weekly deadline to the equity after the step at the next deadline; the first cluster starts from the summed member capital before the first step, so the first build cost is included; all member legs in a period belong to one cluster
statistics.return: cluster equity change divided by gross_budget_usd
statistics.paired_excess: candidate cluster return minus the baseline cluster return for the same period
statistics.inference: mean with a Newey-West (Bartlett kernel) long-run variance at lag_weeks; effective clusters n_eff = n * sample variance / long-run variance, capped at n
statistics.lag_reason: the longest return or volatility lookback is 28 daily bars (4 weeks), so overlapping holdings can link up to 4 adjacent clusters
statistics.family_reason: 6 tried variants x 4 tested hypotheses (net return and excess over each of 3 baselines); Bonferroni per-test level alpha / 24
statistics.sufficiency_reason: 52 weekly clusters is one year of rebalance clusters; each tested series must reach it in count and in n_eff, else the study is an unscored diagnostic

verdict_rules.accounting: every held-out replay (candidate at primary and stressed cost, three baselines) must have replay status complete; otherwise the study is inconclusive with scored=false and no valid economic result
verdict_rules.sufficiency: every tested series reaches min_clusters and min_effective_clusters and has a defined long-run variance; otherwise inconclusive with scored=false

conditions.net_positive: true when the corrected one-sided lower bound of the candidate mean weekly return is above 0; false when the mean is at or below 0; else unknown
conditions.beats_equal_weight_hold: the same rule on the paired excess over equal_weight_hold
conditions.beats_momentum: the same rule on the paired excess over momentum
conditions.beats_vol_momentum: the same rule on the paired excess over vol_momentum
conditions.stress_net_positive: true when the candidate held-out total return at stressed cost is above 0, else false
conditions.not_concentrated: true when the largest single member share of the summed positive member PnL is at most 0.5, else false

verdict_rules.pass: accounting complete, sufficient, every condition true
verdict_rules.fail: accounting complete, sufficient, and any of net_positive, the three beats conditions or stress_net_positive false
verdict_rules.metadata: fail records edge_source study_fail and inconclusive records study_inconclusive, both with edge_ref REPORT.md; a pass keeps edge_source unvalidated and edge_status no_edge until a separate promotion change; live basket use stays refused for every outcome; the driver never edits registry metadata, live defaults or deployed configuration
